---
title: "Schedule"
subtitle: "Conservation Biology"
date: "January 11, 2026"
date-modified: today
format: html
image: "figures/course_header.png"
params:
  course: "conbio_26s"
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

here::i_am("conbio/schedule.qmd")
source(here::here("_common.R"))
course_short <- str_extract(params$course, "\\w+(?=_)")
semester     <- str_remove(params$course, "\\w+_")
source(here(sprintf("%s/schedule/agendas.R", course_short)))


first <- semesters[[semester]][["start_class"]]
last  <- semesters[[semester]][["end_class"]]

schedule_data  <- as.list(seq.Date(
  semesters[[semester]][["start_class"]], 
  semesters[[semester]][["end_class"]]
  )) %>% 
  map(\(x) ymd_hm(sprintf("%s %s", x, course_info[[params$course]][["start_time"]]), tz = "America/Chicago")) %>%
  discard(\(x) wday(x) %in% c(7, 1)) %>%
  set_names(rep(paste0("W", 1:16), each = 5)) %>%
  split(., names(.)) %>%
  map(\(x) keep(x, \(y) wday(y) %in% course_info[[params$course]][["wdays"]])) %>%
  map(\(x) set_names(x, paste0("D", seq_along(x)))) %>%
  enframe(name = "Week") %>%
  unnest_longer("value", indices_to = "Day", values_to = "Date") %>%
  select(Week, Day, Date) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      Week = "Finals",
      Day  = "D1",
      Date = course_info[[params$course]][["final_exam"]]
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(agendas, by = c("Week", "Day")) %>%
  mutate(
    Day = if_else((is.na(topic) & is.na(agenda)) | topic %in% c("Holiday", "Spring Break", "Fall Break", "No Class"), "NO CLASS", Day)
    )

save(schedule_data, file = sprintf("%s/schedule_data.RData", course_short))

```

## Course Schedule

:::{.callout-important}

This schedule is tentative and subject to change at any time, so check the online version regularly. You are solely responsible for keeping up with assigned textbook readings, exams, and assignment deadlines. We may also complete graded, in-class activities or quizzes not listed here without notice.

:::

```{r}
#| include: false

schedule <- reactable(
  schedule_data,
  groupBy = "Week",
  highlight  = TRUE,
  elementId  = "schedule",
  searchable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 20,
  theme      = journal(),
  columns    = list(
    Week = colDef(
      "",
      maxWidth = 60
    ),
    Day = colDef(
      "",
      maxWidth = 50
    ),
    Date = colDef(
      "",
      format = colFormat(datetime = TRUE),
      aggregate = "min"
    ),
    reading = colDef(
      header = tippy::tippy("Reading", "Read these textbook sections before class on the date listed."),
      aggregate = "unique",
      minWidth = 150
    ),
    topic  = colDef(
      "Ch/Topic",
      aggregate = "unique",
      minWidth  = 200
      ),
    agenda = colDef(
      header = tippy::tippy("Class Agenda", "Case Conversations will be student-led. This agenda may change without notice to include graded, in-class excercises or quizzes."),
      aggregate = "unique",
      minWidth = 200
    ),
    materials = colDef(
      "",
      maxWidth = 50,
      cell = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) { return("") } else {
          tags$a(href = sprintf("https://rich-molecular-health-lab.github.io/%s", value), shiny::icon("file-circle-check"))
        }
      }
    )
  )
)

```

```{r}

tags$button(
      class = "btn btn-primary",
     "Expand/Collapse All Weeks",
     onclick = "Reactable.toggleAllRowsExpanded('schedule')",
     )
```
